# User test processes and their plain-go children preserve the caller's
# experiment environment. The logos build still applies its configured defaults.
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOPROXY=off
env GOEXPERIMENT=
cd m

env WANT_EXPERIMENT=
env WANT_PRESENT=true
env WANT_ARENA=on
env WANT_JSONV2=on
logos test -count=1 -run '^TestExperimentEnvironment$' .

env WANT_EXPERIMENT=
env WANT_ARENA=off
go test -count=1 -run '^TestExperimentEnvironment$' .

env GOEXPERIMENT=none
env WANT_EXPERIMENT=none
env WANT_ARENA=on
env WANT_JSONV2=off
logos test -count=1 -run '^TestExperimentEnvironment$' .

env GOEXPERIMENT=nojsonv2
env WANT_EXPERIMENT=nojsonv2
logos test -count=1 -run '^TestExperimentEnvironment$' .

env GOEXPERIMENT=jsonv2
env WANT_EXPERIMENT=jsonv2
env WANT_JSONV2=on
logos test -count=1 -run '^TestExperimentEnvironment$' .

cp arena-off.toml logos.toml
env GOEXPERIMENT=none
env WANT_EXPERIMENT=none
env WANT_ARENA=off
env WANT_JSONV2=off
logos test -count=1 -run '^TestExperimentEnvironment$' .
go test -count=1 -run '^TestExperimentEnvironment$' .

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/testenv

go 1.27
-- m/arena-off.toml --
[build]
arena = false
-- m/arena_on.go --
//go:build goexperiment.logosarena

package testenv

const arena = "on"
-- m/arena_off.go --
//go:build !goexperiment.logosarena

package testenv

const arena = "off"
-- m/json_on.go --
//go:build goexperiment.jsonv2

package testenv

const jsonv2 = "on"
-- m/json_off.go --
//go:build !goexperiment.jsonv2

package testenv

const jsonv2 = "off"
-- m/env_test.go --
package testenv

import (
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestExperimentEnvironment(t *testing.T) {
	want := os.Getenv("WANT_EXPERIMENT")
	got, present := os.LookupEnv("GOEXPERIMENT")
	if got != want || present != (os.Getenv("WANT_PRESENT") == "true") {
		t.Errorf("test GOEXPERIMENT = (%q, %v), want (%q, %s)", got, present, want, os.Getenv("WANT_PRESENT"))
	}
	out, err := exec.Command("go", "env", "GOEXPERIMENT").CombinedOutput()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("child go env: %v\n%s", err, out)
	}
	if got := strings.TrimSpace(string(out)); got != want {
		t.Errorf("child GOEXPERIMENT = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
	if want := os.Getenv("WANT_ARENA"); arena != want {
		t.Errorf("compiled arena = %s, want %s", arena, want)
	}
	if want := os.Getenv("WANT_JSONV2"); jsonv2 != want {
		t.Errorf("compiled jsonv2 = %s, want %s", jsonv2, want)
	}
}
